name: Facultative Reinsurance Specialist / Underwriter
description: Owns facultative placement across the Reinsurance value stream, from registering inbound submissions through slip preparation, contract wording finalization, and execution. Structures retrocessions, sets net retentions, and prepares recovery billing statements to reinsurers, while supporting reinsurance governance committee packs, regulatory reporting, and cedant compliance monitoring against notification thresholds.

name: Field Claims Adjuster
description: Performs on-site claim handling within the Claims value stream, evaluating liability, documenting decisions, and managing files through resolution. Coordinates emergency mitigation, structured settlement placements, and release agreements, orders IMEs when evidence is insufficient, and manages denials with appeal follow-ups. Rebalances misrouted claims and maintains vendor network directories and routing rules.

name: FinOps Analyst
description: Performs cloud financial operations for Technology & Engineering, producing rolling spend forecasts, cost trend dashboards, and bottom-up annual cloud budgets by team. Drives chargeback reporting by mapping accounts to cost centers, allocating shared platform costs, and reconciling amounts to the ledger. Executes resource optimization through rightsizing, off-hours scheduling, and remediation of untagged resources.

name: FinOps Lead
description: Leads platform reliability and service operations across Technology & Engineering and Data & AI, covering alert intake, severity classification, and on-call assignment through the observability platform. Manages IT service request fulfillment against access policy, hypercare and post-release support, and data pipeline incident response. Drives resilience improvements, including closed-loop self-healing and recovery verification via smoke tests.

name: Finance Operations Analyst
description: Performs core finance operations across the Finance & Investments value stream, supporting GAAP financial reporting, capital instruments management, and reinsurance accounting. Runs accounts payable disbursement from invoice batching through payment release, validates subledger-to-GL postings, and prepares Schedule F exhibits and ORSA capital narratives. Supports rolling forecasts, financial examinations, and post-close M&A integration.

name: Financial Analyst
description: Performs financial analysis for Planning & Capital within the Finance & Investments value stream, analyzing profitability drivers by product and segment and compiling the quarterly financial supplement. Supports GAAP financial reporting, solvency reporting, and rolling forecasts, reconciles allocated capital to the consolidated position, and prepares ORSA summaries and capital narratives alongside M&A financial support.

name: Financial Crime AML Officer
description: Oversees compliance issue response within Risk, Compliance & Audit, logging and triaging issues, assigning investigation leads, and escalating major matters to the CCO. Manages regulatory change and examination corrective-action plans, validates KRI data quality against the risk appetite framework, and monitors third-party and cyber risk, feeding vendor incidents into the operational risk register.

name: Financial Crime Investigator
description: Performs financial crime investigations within Risk, Compliance & Audit, adjudicating screening alerts, investigating escalated potential true matches, and documenting disposition rationale. Supports suspicious activity reporting, customer due diligence, and anti-bribery controls including PEP and corruption screening of third parties. Maintains BSA/AML policy, tunes screening thresholds, and prepares AML examination response packages.

name: General Counsel
description: Leads the legal function across Legal & Corporate Governance, directing regulatory filing management, defense management, and enforcement resolutions including regulator negotiations with the DOI. Oversees Holding Company Act compliance, intellectual property, contract negotiation, and employment law advisory, while maintaining board composition records, reporting director changes to regulators, and running legal operations metrics.

name: Governance Analyst
description: Coordinates corporate governance operations across Legal & Corporate Governance, planning board meetings, circulating minutes, and tracking action items and director continuing education to closure. Administers entity licensing, regulatory filings and correspondence, and governance policy management including signing authority and officer roster validation. Supports complaint dispute handling, legal records retention, and annual governance disclosures.

name: Government Affairs Manager
description: Coordinates public affairs and regulatory engagement within Legal & Corporate Governance, responding to regulator objection letters and negotiating resolutions with the DOI. Administers political contributions compliance including PAC reporting to governance, supports board meeting planning and evaluations, and maintains director fee and equity records. Prepares executive stakeholder briefings and secures business sign-off on commercial terms.

name: HR Business Partner
description: Owns employee relations case management and organizational change within the Human Resources & Talent value stream, conducting change impact analyses and building retention strategies for critical roles. Governs HR policy acknowledgment, disciplinary actions, and new hire orientation including 30-60-90 day plans, while maintaining personnel files and validating headcount and attrition data for workforce insight reporting.

name: HR Coordinator
description: Coordinates day-to-day HR administration across the Human Resources & Talent value stream, running E-Verify cases, capturing benefit elections, and recording workforce transitions in the HCM. Supports performance and talent reviews by monitoring candidate progress and updating readiness ratings, applies statutory deductions, and escalates systemic retention issues to business leaders with people analytics reporting.
